row_format: id boundary early(trigger stop threshold target) late(trigger stop threshold target) band1 band2 post0(threshold target) post1(threshold target) post2(threshold target) restock partial [startchance [fortress(trigger stop threshold target) water(trigger stop threshold target)]]

progression.-2: four early story routines before Fortress / Fortress-Water / Water-Wind / Wind-full

canonical_semantic_domains.startchance: 0..101 (101 never enters; canonicalize to no-early routine)

wager: If b>threshold wager1. Otherwise target<0 gives min(-target,101-b); nonnegative target gives max(1,target-b+1). Values outside legal held-shell/probability bounds are rejected, except the explicit partial fallback. Threshold equality chooses target branch.
early: beginvisit is full OR (S>=trigger AND b>=startchance); active persists only within visit. Stop when inactive, S<=stop or pool exhausted. Unaffordable wager spends all S if partial enabled, otherwise ends visit. No early restocking.
post: Band0 if S<=band1, Band1 if S<=band2, otherwise Band2. Try requested wager; if short and partial enabled with S>0 use all shells. Otherwise restock.

restock.1: minimum bundles needed for requested wager, bounded by regional max/cap/wallet
restock.2: if at least one bundle already funded, buy maximum already-affordable batch; otherwise maximum permitted batch

regional_branch: PAL price300/max3, NTSC-U price200/max4. Missing money obtained via integer ceil((purchase cost-R)/20) pickups. No policy branch queries future resources, route/event indices, F or RNG.
canonicalization: Use complexity_audit.normalize for unused targets and identical ordinary early rows
Collapse absent inventory bands and adjacent identical post rows
Every probability threshold outside observable range reduces to its boundary behavior
Fixed shell -1 is one-shell; -100 at probability cap is displayed-100
Values below empty reserve become0; triggers beyond shell cap become no-early; equivalent no-early gating canonicalizes to trigger1000
Equivalent aliases receive their minimum published-convention complexity before behavioral deduplication
Keep distinct restocking modes even if their current rounded expectations coincide
parser_limitation: The C++ parser itself accepts arbitrary integers and is not a finite validated grammar. Enumeration concerns canonical legal behavior, not infinitely many redundant serialized integer aliases.
exhaustive_C8_partition_proof: Every representative has P>=1,L>=2,B>=1 and C>=7. A C<=8 representative has S=I=M=0 and P=1. C7 requires L=2,B=1,Q=0: same early/post constant one-shell or displayed100, restock0/1 (4). C8 is exactly one added Q, L or B unit: shared threshold1..99 x restock0/1 (198); different early/post constants x restock0/1 (4); no early/post constant x restock0/1 (4); shared100 with meaningful partial fallback x restock0/1 (2); funded-first universal constants (2). No extra progression, inventory threshold, intermediate target or session gate fits C8. This is a canonical behavioral quotient, not enumeration of raw alias strings.
C15_lower_bound_family: For g=3..999 and stop=1..g-2, choose early constant1/100 and post constant1/100, restock0/1, partial0, startchance0.
